visualCharacteristics.purpose: Blog listing title with a labelled keyword search box; results from the query index are listed under the form

contentPattern.structure: Cells: 1) heading (optionally followed by a paragraph used as the search label); 2) input placeholder text, e.g. "e.g. destination"; 3) optional query index path or link (defaults to /query-index.json). Results are limited to pages under the current page path when any exist

reuseGuidance: Use at the top of the blog landing page. Requires the article pages to be in the query index.
